{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Earth Rooster''' (己酉, ''tsuchinoto tori''; onyomi ''kishū'') is the 46th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 46th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Earth Monkey|ja|戊申|1=Yang Earth Monkey}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Metal Dog|ja|庚戌|1=Yang Metal Dog}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''己'' is Yin Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''酉'' (Rooster) is Yin Metal; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Earth Rooster (己酉)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jǐyǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gei2 jau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoto-tori
*** On'yomi: kishū
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): giyu (기유)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Kỷ Dậu

=== Events ===
* In {{ill|Keichō|en|Keichō|qid=Q1328185|lt=Keichō era|1=Keichō}} 14 (1609 AD), the {{ill|Treaty of Tsuchinoto-tori|ja|己酉約条|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Treaty of Tsuchinoto-tori|1=Japan–Korea Agreement of 1609|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11479876}} (Keichō Treaty) was concluded.

==Months of Yin Earth Rooster==
In years where the last digit is 2 or 7 (where the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} is {{ill|Rin|ja|壬|1=Mizunoe (壬)|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Rin}} or {{ill|Tei|ja|丁|1=Hinoto (丁)|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tei}}), the eighth month corresponds to the month of Tsuchinoto-tori. However, this may refer to the {{ill|Lunisolar calendar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar calendar}} or the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Bailu (solar term)|en|Bailu (solar term)|qid=Q1191003|lt=Hakuro (solar term)|1=Bailu (solar term)}} to the day before {{ill|Hanlu|en|Hanlu|qid=Q1193124|lt=Kanro|1=Hanlu}}).
